title: Backend provenance and CUDA diagnostics
text: Diagnostics non-destructive: inspect optional torch runtime never install download . Device requests follow rules: "cpu" explicit always uses portable backend. "cuda" strict. CUDA unavailable, call raises cudaverse_cuda_unavailable error; fall back. "auto" uses CUDA diagnostics report usable device. Otherwise selects CPU records fallback = TRUE plus stable reason torch_not_installed cuda_unavailable. Prediction’s "model" choice reuses fitted object’s actual device records requested_device = "inherited" selection_reason = "model_device". title: Backend provenance and CUDA diagnostics
text: cuda_pca() accepts dense observation--feature matrix. double matrix alone uses roughly 8 * nrow(x) * ncol(x) bytes, centring, scaling, SVD, CPU/GPU copies require additional working memory. Reduce number observations features PCA dense representation large. cuda_distance() intentionally returns complete dense pairwise matrix, requiring 8 * nrow(x) * nrow(y) bytes doubles. CPU Euclidean path applies common translation global scaling vectorized calculation, recomputes numerically risky pairs direct, scale-first differences. avoids cancellation large squared norms avoids avoidable overflow underflow. cuda_knn() exact quadratic time, batch_size bounds resident distance block approximately 8 * min(batch_size, nrow(x)) * nrow(x) bytes. returned distance matrix uses 8 * nrow(x) * k bytes, addition integer index matrix. Lower batch_size reduce peak memory; change selected neighbours.
